question: Which of the following structures is formed with a closed chain of carbon atoms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ring structure**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A** ring structure** can refer to a simple cycle of atoms and bonds in a molecule or to a connected set of atoms and bonds where every atom and bond is a part of a cycle. This is also known as a **ring system**.
 
• A ring system that forms a simple cycle is called a **monocycle** or **simple ring**, and one that is not a simple cycle is called a **polycycle**&a
